body_text:
The residue of $f$ at an isolated singularity $z_0$ is the
coefficient $a_{-1}$ in its Laurent expansion, written
$\operatorname{Res}(f,z_0)$. Equivalently, for a sufficiently
small positively oriented circle $\gamma$ around $z_0$,
$\operatorname{Res}(f,z_0)=\frac{1}{2\pi i}
\int_\gamma f(z)\,dz$.
